response: {"text":"We have carried out an up‑to‑date review of how rain impacts surfaces at speeds below and above the speed of sound. The paper looks at earlier work on the subject, covering both low‑speed and high‑speed conditions. It also outlines the test rigs that are currently used to reproduce the effect of rain on materials, and it summarizes the findings from previous studies on different substances. The authors suggest ways to make laboratory tests more realistic for fast rain impacts and point to promising directions for creating new, more resistant materials."}
